title: Analysis of Types of Inquiries in Student-AI Interaction: A case study of two CS2 tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.17919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background and Context: Question and inquiry are integral parts of knowledge seeking and learning. Despite their importance, students tend not to ask enough questions in the classroom. However, studies have shown that students interact extensively with generative AI systems for learning and problem solving.   Objective: In this paper, we seek to better understand the types of questions that students ask AI systems, and how those questions evolve during problem solving and across tasks.   Method: We use the Graesser et al. taxonomy to classify students' inquiries into 18 types. We develop a few-shot learning approach to automatically classify students' interactions with AI into these categories. We use this system to analyze 830 interactions of CS2 students across two programming tasks. translated_title: 学生与AI互动中问题类型分析：两项CS2任务的案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17919v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：背景与上下文：提问和探究是知识寻求和学习的重要组成部分。尽管它们很重要，但学生在课堂上往往不会提出足够的问题。然而，研究表明，学生广泛与生成式AI系统互动以进行学习和解决问题。目标：在本文中，我们旨在更好地理解学生向AI系统提出的问题类型，以及这些问题在问题解决过程中和跨任务间如何演变。方法：我们使用Graesser等人的分类法将学生的提问分为18种类型。我们开发了一种少样本学习方法，自动将学生与AI的互动分类到这些类别中。我们使用该系统分析了CS2学生在两项编程任务中的830次互动。发现：我们的结果表明，少数问题类型占据了学生提问的大多数，且问题类型在任务间保持稳定。
tldr: 本文通过少样本学习分类方法，发现CS2学生在与AI互动中提出的问题主要集中于少数几种类型，且这些类型在任务间保持稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a few-shot learning classification method to find that CS2 students' inquiries in AI interactions are dominated by a few question types, which remain stable across tasks.
